entries.title: Hosea 6:1
segments: ¶Come, and let us return to the LORD; For He has torn, but He will heal us; He has stricken, but He will bind us up.

entries.title: Hosea 6:2
segments: After two days He will revive us; On the third day He will raise us up, That we may live in His sight.

entries.title: Hosea 6:3
segments: Let us know, Let us pursue the knowledge of the LORD. His going forth is established as the morning; He will come to us like the rain, Like the latter [and] former rain to the earth.

entries.title: Hosea 6:4
segments: ¶"O Ephraim, what shall I do to you? O Judah, what shall I do to you? For your faithfulness is like a morning cloud, And like the early dew it goes away.

entries.title: Hosea 6:5
segments: Therefore I have hewn [them] by the prophets, I have slain them by the words of My mouth; And your judgments [are like] light [that] goes forth.

entries.title: Hosea 6:6
segments: For I desire mercy and not sacrifice, And the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

entries.title: Hosea 6:7
segments: "But like men they transgressed the covenant; There they dealt treacherously with Me.

entries.title: Hosea 6:8
segments: Gilead [is] a city of evildoers, [And] defiled with blood.

entries.title: Hosea 6:9
segments: As bands of robbers lie in wait for a man, [So] the company of priests murder on the way to Shechem; Surely they commit lewdness.

entries.title: Hosea 6:10
segments: I have seen a horrible thing in the house of Israel: There [is] the harlotry of Ephraim; Israel is defiled.

entries.title: Hosea 6:11
segments: Also, O Judah, a harvest is appointed for you, When I return the captives of My people.
